$comment: Canonical business capability roadmap and website discovery metadata. Edit this file, then run `pnpm gen:capabilities` to regenerate the tables in docs/BUSINESS-CAPABILITY-ROADMAP.md and the website's discovery-index.json. `pnpm check:capabilities` fails if either is stale, an evidence reference does not resolve, or a discovery reference names something that does not exist.

capabilities.name: DataGrid
capabilities.notes: Shipped (React): row virtualization, column resize, drag reorder, pinning, client sort, editable cells, range selection and copy, full keyboard model. Missing: server-driven sort/filter hooks, row groups, expandable rows, column visibility and density controls, a batch-action toolbar, cell validation, pagination or infinite loading. Pinning is spelled `left`/`right`, not start/end — an RTL contract defect to fix before extending. Native ports are a documented scope-down; Angular is planned.

capabilities.name: DataTable
capabilities.notes: TanStack-based table on React plus native ports; the light alternative to DataGrid. Angular planned (data wave).

capabilities.name: DataGrid advanced
capabilities.notes: Advanced organisational value (analyst tooling), not difficulty, is why this is a Pro candidate. Keyboard, RTL and accessibility of the base grid stay Core.

capabilities.name: QueryBuilder
capabilities.notes: A rule tree with a keyboard-operable add/remove/reorder model. The query it produces is data the product executes; the component never runs it.

capabilities.name: FilterBar
capabilities.notes: Today a block (removable tags, a price slider, the filters behind them) assembled from Tag and MultiSelect. Promote to a component once two consumers (DataGrid, QueryBuilder) need the same chip contract.

capabilities.name: MetricCard
capabilities.notes: Metric already has label, value, trend, change, icon and a chart slot on all five platforms — it IS MetricCard under another name. Missing: progress toward a goal, and a built-in sparkline (bring-your-own today). Extend Metric; do not add MetricCard.

capabilities.name: PivotTable
capabilities.notes: Analyst tooling. Pro candidate.

capabilities.name: Chart infrastructure
capabilities.notes: React: ChartContainer, tooltip, legend, loading/empty/error states and a screen-reader data table on Recharts. Reference lines and brush exist as recipes; a crosshair does not. Natives ship a narrower KinetixChart; Angular planned. No new charting dependency without an architecture review.

capabilities.name: Core chart types
capabilities.notes: Shipped as React recipes on /charts (themed Recharts compositions), not exported components. Exporting typed components is a Phase 3 decision, and native parity is narrower.

capabilities.name: Gauge
capabilities.notes: Gauge is a /charts recipe; ProgressRing exists as CircularProgress on all five platforms.

capabilities.name: Advanced chart types
capabilities.notes: All seven ship as React recipes on /charts (plus Sankey, bullet, bump, dumbbell). Web-first; no native recipes.

capabilities.name: RangeChart
capabilities.notes: Min/max band over time (forecast ranges, vital ranges). A recipe on the existing infrastructure.

capabilities.name: TimelineChart
capabilities.notes: Events on a time axis; overlaps Scheduling's TimelinePlanner — build once.

capabilities.name: GanttChart
capabilities.notes: Dependency-aware planning is advanced organisational tooling.

capabilities.name: ResultState
capabilities.notes: Phase 1. One foundation for PaymentSuccess, BookingConfirmed, OrderConfirmed, RefundConfirmed, TransferSuccess, ApplicationSubmitted, TicketIssued, VoucherRedeemed. success, error, warning, pending, info and partial. React-first; natives compose KinetixEmpty; Angular planned.

capabilities.name: SuccessState / ErrorState / WarningState / PendingState / PartialSuccessState
capabilities.notes: Not separate components: each is `<ResultState status="…">`. Listed so nobody builds them.

capabilities.name: ReferenceCode
capabilities.notes: Phase 1. Selectable, copyable, announced; honest failure path when the clipboard is unavailable.

capabilities.name: PriceBreakdown
capabilities.notes: Phase 1. Subtotal, tax, fees, discount, shipping, credit, total — values supplied formatted; no commerce-only wording.

capabilities.name: SummaryList / KeyValueList
capabilities.notes: Exists as DescriptionList on all five platforms. No new component. Its term column is a fixed 6rem mono caps skin; a `variant` for plain summaries is a candidate follow-up, not a new primitive.

capabilities.name: PassCard
capabilities.notes: Phase 1. Foundation for boarding passes, tickets, vouchers, permits, memberships. Renders a supplied code; never encodes.

capabilities.name: TicketCard
capabilities.notes: A PassCard composition (a stub after PassCardDivider), shown on the PassCard page. Not a component.

capabilities.name: TransactionCard
capabilities.notes: Deferred from Phase 1 on purpose: its amount, sign and status vocabulary belong to the money-display contract (AmountDisplay, TransactionRow). Building it first would freeze that API by accident.

capabilities.name: Receipt
capabilities.notes: Phase 2. A beta block on all five platforms: Card + AmountDisplay + ReferenceCode + DescriptionList (date, payment method, payee) + PriceBreakdown. Download, Print and Share are callbacks only: no PDF, print or payment infrastructure. ReceiptLine/Total/Tax ARE PriceBreakdownLine/Total.

capabilities.name: StatusTimeline
capabilities.notes: Phase 2: React's Timeline now takes a per-item `status` (complete, current, pending, warning, error, neutral) with a distinct marker shape and a spoken word per status, `aria-current="step"`, an optional per-item action, and logical alignment (RTL-converted). Angular's KxTimelineItem has default/active/success/error but no pending or warning and does not speak its status. SwiftUI, Compose and Flutter timelines have no status yet, so this stays partial.

capabilities.name: Domain result screens
capabilities.notes: Blocks (or docs recipes) composed from the foundations — never components.

capabilities.name: ProductCard
capabilities.notes: Domain composition over Card; price via AmountDisplay, availability as text plus a status Tag.

capabilities.name: ProductVariant / ProductOption
capabilities.notes: Mostly a recipe over ToggleGroup (size, colour swatches with names, not colour alone).

capabilities.name: ProductQuantity / CartQuantity / QuantityPicker
capabilities.notes: Phase 2: NumberInput IS the QuantityPicker contract, now with localisable stepper names, `aria-disabled` bounds that keep keyboard focus, and a polite announcement of stepper changes. No separate QuantityPicker component. The order-summary block uses it per line.

capabilities.name: Cart
capabilities.notes: order-summary block hand-rolls its totals; migrate them onto PriceBreakdown.

capabilities.name: CartDrawer / MiniCart
capabilities.notes: Sheet + Cart composition.

capabilities.name: Checkout
capabilities.notes: A block. Never a component.

capabilities.name: OrderSummary
capabilities.notes: Exists as the order-summary block (five platforms). Its lines are PriceBreakdown lines — no OrderLine/OrderTotal components.

capabilities.name: OrderCard
capabilities.notes: OrderTimeline is StatusTimeline.

capabilities.name: ReturnRequest
capabilities.notes: Block.

capabilities.name: RefundSummary / RefundStatus
capabilities.notes: Composition of Phase 1 foundations.

capabilities.name: AvailabilityPicker / AppointmentPicker
capabilities.notes: Calendar with availability (disabled/limited days announced, not only greyed).

capabilities.name: TimeSlotPicker
capabilities.notes: Phase 2. React beta: a Radix radio group of tiles (arrow keys across periods, Space selects), unavailable slots disabled, struck through and spoken, limited slots carry a note, empty state, and a stated time zone; times are never converted. Native tabs show a composition; Angular planned.

capabilities.name: GuestPicker
capabilities.notes: Phase 2. React beta composed from NumberInput steppers in a Popover: per-category and total limits, a summary on the trigger, every label supplied. Native tabs show a composition; Angular planned.

capabilities.name: ResourcePicker / ProviderPicker / LocationPicker / ServicePicker
capabilities.notes: One picker pattern (searchable list of rich options) — a recipe over Command/Select, not four components.

capabilities.name: BookingCard / ReservationCard
capabilities.notes: BookingReference is ReferenceCode; BookingStatus is a Tag; a reservation confirmation is a PassCard composition.

capabilities.name: BookingTimeline
capabilities.notes: StatusTimeline.

capabilities.name: Booking flow
capabilities.notes: Block.

capabilities.name: FlightCard
capabilities.notes: Route and times as text with machine-readable `<time>`; direction-aware route arrow.

capabilities.name: BaggageAllowance / GateInfo / BoardingGroup
capabilities.notes: Fields, not components.

capabilities.name: BoardingPass
capabilities.notes: Shown as the PassCard demo. A domain wrapper may come later; the base never says "flight".

capabilities.name: TrainTicket / BusTicket / EventTicket
capabilities.notes: PassCard compositions (EventTicket is on the PassCard page).

capabilities.name: SeatMap
capabilities.notes: Hard accessibility problem (2D grid, roving focus, availability not by colour). Web-first; dedicated design spike before code.

capabilities.name: Itinerary
capabilities.notes: ItineraryTimeline is StatusTimeline.

capabilities.name: TripSummary / TripPriceBreakdown / TripStatus
capabilities.notes: TripPriceBreakdown is PriceBreakdown.

capabilities.name: PassCard foundation
capabilities.notes: Shipped as PassCard*: PassHolder is PassCardDescription or a field; PassValidity is a PassCardField with `<time>`; PassStatus composes Tag; PassTerms is PassCardFooter.

capabilities.name: PassBarcode / PassQRCode
capabilities.notes: PassCardCode renders a SUPPLIED barcode or QR image with a text alternative and readable value. Encoding stays out of the library — no barcode dependency, no invented security model.

capabilities.name: Pass compositions
capabilities.notes: Compositions of PassCard (parking permit and voucher are on the PassCard page). Promote one to a component only when its behaviour, not its words, differs.

capabilities.name: Wallet export (Apple Wallet / Google Wallet)
capabilities.notes: Platform wallet passes are issued server-side by the product; out of scope for a UI library.

capabilities.name: Invoice
capabilities.notes: InvoiceLine is a Table row; InvoiceTotals is PriceBreakdown.

capabilities.name: Receipt blocks
capabilities.notes: The payment receipt exists as the Receipt block; booking, transfer, order and refund receipts are word changes over it and are not written as separate blocks yet.

capabilities.name: AmountDisplay
capabilities.notes: Phase 2. React beta: formatted value supplied by the product (never calculated), real minus or plus sign spoken as a word, tone independent of sign (a refund is negative and good), tabular figures, its own `dir="auto"` run, optional full screen-reader label. Native tabs show a composition; Angular planned (data wave).

capabilities.name: MoneyInput
capabilities.notes: Locale-aware entry; the stored value is the product's minor-unit integer, never a float.

capabilities.name: PercentageInput / UnitInput
capabilities.notes: NumberInput + InputGroup addon covers it today.

capabilities.name: IBANInput / AccountNumberInput
capabilities.notes: Formatting and checksum hints only; validation authority stays server-side.

capabilities.name: PaymentCardInput
capabilities.notes: Never claim PCI compliance: a UI component cannot provide it. Most products should use their PSP's hosted fields; this would be for PSP-agnostic styling only.

capabilities.name: MoneyMovementSummary / FeeBreakdown

capabilities.name: PricingTable

capabilities.name: Upgrade / downgrade / cancel flows
capabilities.notes: Blocks.

capabilities.name: WalletTransaction

capabilities.name: WalletCard / GiftCard / LoyaltyCard

capabilities.name: WorkspaceSwitcher

capabilities.name: SessionManager / DeviceSession

capabilities.name: APIKeyTable / SecretKeyManager

capabilities.name: AuthShell / AuthCard

capabilities.name: PasswordStrength / PasswordRequirement

capabilities.name: KYC flow

capabilities.name: FileUploader

capabilities.name: DocumentViewer shell

capabilities.name: PatientSummary / PatientStatus / PatientAlert

capabilities.name: DeviceAlert

capabilities.name: ZoneSummary

capabilities.name: MessageBubble / Conversation / Thread

capabilities.name: StatusCard / StatusIndicator

capabilities.name: IncidentBanner
capabilities.notes: Banner (dismissible, intent-tinted, page-level).

capabilities.name: AlertRuleBuilder
capabilities.notes: QueryBuilder with thresholds.

capabilities.name: ChatMessage / AssistantResponse / StreamingText
capabilities.notes: MessageBubble + rendered markdown; streaming announcement strategy (polite, chunked) is the gap.

capabilities.name: ToolCall / Citation / SourcesPanel
capabilities.notes: User-visible tool and source information only.

capabilities.name: AgentTask
capabilities.notes: Shows user-visible execution status only — never hidden chain-of-thought.

capabilities.name: AppShell / Sidebar / Header
capabilities.notes: Sidebar, AppBar, NavigationBar.

capabilities.name: PageHeader / ContextBar
capabilities.notes: PageHeader; ContextBar is a PageHeader slot.

capabilities.name: SplitPane / ResizablePanels
capabilities.notes: Resizable.

capabilities.name: MasterDetail
capabilities.notes: A responsive recipe (split on wide, push on narrow).

capabilities.name: StatusBanner / InlineStatus
capabilities.notes: Banner, Inform, Alert.

capabilities.name: ProcessingState / PendingState
capabilities.notes: ResultState status="pending" for a whole result; Spinner inline.

capabilities.name: SyncStatus / ConnectionStatus / StaleDataState / OfflineState
capabilities.notes: The IoT freshness and connectivity contract already exists; lifting a domain-neutral version into Core (with IoT re-using it) is the job — do not fork a second model.

capabilities.name: ConflictState / MaintenanceState
capabilities.notes: ResultState and Banner variants with resolution actions.

capabilities.name: FormSection / FieldArray / RepeatableFieldGroup / ConditionalField / DependentSelect
capabilities.notes: Form (react-hook-form) and Field exist; repeatable groups and dependent selects are recipes to write.

capabilities.name: AddressForm / PhoneInput / CountrySelect / TimezoneSelect
capabilities.notes: Phase 2: AddressForm shipped as AddressFields (fields in a fieldset, not a `<form>`; order, labels and requiredness supplied per country; section-prefixed autocomplete tokens; no postal database). PhoneInput (native calling-code select + tel field, `dir="ltr"`, raw value, paste detection, no validation and no numbering database) and CountrySelect (combobox recipe over a supplied list; a flag is never the only identifier) are React betas. TimezoneSelect is not built.

capabilities.name: DateRangeInput / DateTimeRangeInput
capabilities.notes: Phase 2: DateRangeInput is a React beta over Calendar range mode in a Popover with ISO calendar-date strings, so no time zone moves a booking; Calendar's chevrons now mirror under RTL. DateTimeRangeInput is not built.

capabilities.name: Core motion
capabilities.notes: Token-based durations and easings, reduced-motion evidence in CI. Primitives are not yet exported as components. Never paywalled.

capabilities.name: Pro motion
capabilities.notes: Not in Phase 1. Accessibility motion (reduced motion, accessible end states) stays Core.

discovery.$comment: Website discovery (Business Discovery W1). Every family belongs to exactly one capability group; a family may also belong to business domains. A family with no domain is domain-neutral: it reaches a domain only through a workflow that uses it. Workflow stages name capability rows above, never components, so what a stage offers is whatever those rows' evidence says ships today. Nothing here may restate a status, a layer or a platform: those stay on the rows and in components.manifest.json. Pro-candidate rows never reach the website (marketing/STRATEGY.md rule 7).
